The material available is thin. No products are tracked for Alphabet, and no MCP servers are recorded. The site text harvested describes only an investor relations home page, so there is no product or AI positioning to report from the company's own words.

The held facts add little beyond the corporate record. Alphabet faces 281 cases in California, the only jurisdiction recorded for it. No lawsuits are listed individually, and no other litigation detail is present.
